front.title: A Lightweight Cross-Layer Simulation Framework for IP-Optical Network Digital Twins

abstract.t:
This document describes a lightweight, event-driven simulation framework for IP-optical Network Digital Twins (NDTs). The framework investigates how optical and transport events propagate across network layers and interact with IP-layer protection, routing convergence, and traffic redistribution.
The framework integrates three capabilities into a unified simulation process: dependency-aware event propagation, causal coordination of IP and optical behaviors on a common simulation timeline, and fidelity-aware evaluation of the resulting service impacts. Cross- layer dependency uncertainty and model limitations are explicitly considered to avoid unsupported resilience conclusions.
The framework uses abstract optical and transport states rather than continuous optical propagation models. It reuses existing IETF topology and management information where applicable and supports reproducible what-if analysis, historical incident replay, and protection-strategy comparison. It does not define new network protocols or YANG modules, and simulation results are not directly applied to production networks.
